about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: PawShop started as a small idea between two cat lovers who couldn't find food their own fussy cats actually enjoyed. Today we bring carefully chosen food, treats and accessories to cat owners across the European Union - no gimmicks, just good products and honest service.
about.paragraph2: Every order is reviewed personally, and we reach out to confirm payment and delivery before anything ships. You're always talking to a real person, not a checkout robot.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: This page explains what personal data we collect when you place an order with PawShop, why we collect it, and how you can exercise your rights under the GDPR.

whatWeCollect.title: What information we collect
whatWeCollect.body: When you submit an order request, we collect your name, phone number, delivery address, and any comment you choose to add. We do not collect payment card details — payment is arranged directly with our manager after we contact you.

whyWeCollect.title: Why we collect it
whyWeCollect.body: We use this information solely to process your order request, arrange delivery, and get in touch with you to confirm payment and shipping details. The legal basis for this processing is the performance of a contract you are entering into with us (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We retain order data for as long as necessary to fulfil your order and to meet our legal and accounting obligations, after which it is deleted or anonymised.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.body: When you submit an order, your name, phone number, delivery address, and comment are sent to our manager as a Telegram notification. Telegram Messenger Inc. is based outside the European Economic Area, so this involves a transfer of your personal data outside the EEA (GDPR Chapter V).

requests.title: Your rights and how to reach us
requests.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at support@pawshop.example. If you request deletion, please note that removing the corresponding Telegram message is a manual step our manager completes as part of processing your request.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.intro: Have a question about a product or an order? Fill in the form below or write to us directly at support@pawshop.example — since there's no online payment, our manager always reaches out personally to confirm your order and delivery details.

Footer.supportText: Questions about your order? We're happy to help.
